name: Manhattan (Kansas, United States)
description: Blue sky over a green hill outlined in white, with a white apple on the hilltop — the "Little Apple on the Prairie".
history: Manhattan is a city in and the county seat of Riley County, Kansas, although the city extends into Pottawatomie County. The flag was adopted in 2019 (the winner of the city's 2019 flag redesign contest, "Little Apple on the Prairie" by Kimberly Medvid, according to Flags of the World).
